tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Searches for news articles using the News API "Everything" endpoint.

q.description: Keywords or phrases to search for in the article title and body.

sources.description: A comma-separated string of identifiers for the news sources or blogs you want headlines from.

domains.description: A comma-separated string of domains (e.g. bbc.co.uk, techcrunch.com) to search within.

excludeDomains.description: A comma-separated string of domains (e.g. bbc.co.uk, techcrunch.com) to exclude from the search.

from.description: A date and optional time for the oldest article allowed. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (e.g. 2024-01-01 or 2024-01-01T10:00:00).

to.description: A date and optional time for the newest article allowed. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

language.description: The 2-letter ISO 639-1 code of the language you want to get headlines for. Possible options: ar, de, en, es, fr, he, it, nl, no, pt, ru, sv, ud, zh. Default: all languages returned.

sortBy.description: The order to sort the articles in. Possible options: relevancy, popularity, publishedAt. Default: relevancy.

pageSize.description: The number of results to return per page (request). 20 is the default, 100 is the maximum.

page.description: Use this to page through the results if the total results found is greater than the pageSize.

tools.name: get_top_headlines
tools.description: Fetches top news headlines using the News API "Top Headlines" endpoint.

q.description: Keywords or phrases to search for in the article title and body.

sources.description: A comma-separated string of identifiers for the news sources or blogs you want headlines from.

category.description: The category you want to get headlines for. Possible options: business, entertainment, general, health, science, sports, technology.

language.description: The 2-letter ISO 639-1 code of the language you want to get headlines for. Possible options: ar, de, en, es, fr, he, it, nl, no, pt, ru, sv, ud, zh. Default: all languages returned.

country.description: The 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code of the country you want to get headlines for. Possible options: ae, ar, at, au, be, bg, br, ca, ch, cn, co, cu, cz, de, eg, fr, gb, gr, hk, hu, id, ie, il, in, it, jp, kr, lt, lv, ma, mx, my, ng, nl, no, nz, ph, pl, pt, ro, rs, ru, sa, se, sg, si, sk, th, tr, tw, ua, us, ve, za. Default: all countries returned.

pageSize.description: The number of results to return per page (request). 20 is the default, 100 is the maximum.

page.description: Use this to page through the results if the total results found is greater than the pageSize.
